input: Brainstorm a name for my new bakery

verdict.notes: Set B has two major redundancy problems: Q2 and Q7 both ask about location, and Q4 partially overlaps with Q6 on naming preferences. It also wastes a question (Q3) asking about an existing business/website, which is irrelevant for someone brainstorming a *new* bakery name, and the title "FMNameBrainstorm" is unprofessional and robotic. Set A is tighter, more natural, and covers a unique and valuable angle (personal story/name incorporation, styles to avoid) that B misses entirely.
